description: Changes one item: values (only the ones you send; null or "" clears one), newSlug (renames the file and its URL), draft (false publishes it with the site), publishedAt, order. Checked against the fields like create_items; a wrong type is refused with the field and why. With locale (a language from list_locales): writes that language's translation of the item instead (content/<collection>/<slug>.<code>.md): values for translatable fields only (shared fields are refused: they are the same in every language), newSlug as the item's slug in that language, draft as that language's publish state (a new translation is a draft unless draft is false); publishedAt and order can't take a locale. Translate only when the user asks. Writes go to the branch the workspace has open, the same as the Content tab. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. Works on every plan within its collection and item limits (Free: 2 collections and 100 items a site); turning a folder into a Xodia collection needs a paid plan.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: The collection id (its folder under content/), from list_collections

draft.description: false publishes it with the site. With locale: this language's publish state

locale.description: Optional: a language code from list_locales (not the default) to read or write the item in that language; leave out for the default language

newSlug.description: Renames the item (its URL changes: add a redirect when it was published). With locale: the item's slug in that language only

values.description: Changed values only; null or "" clears one. With locale: translatable fields only
